description: This file defines constants related to authorization within the org.eclipse.hono.service.auth package. It includes string constants for event bus addresses, field names, and authorization outcomes, as well as a static method to create authorization messages.

classes.name: AuthorizationConstants
classes.description: A final class containing constants used for authorization purposes, including messaging fields and outcomes, and a helper method to generate authorization messages.

methods.name: getAuthorizationMsg
methods.description: Creates a JSON message object containing subject, resource, and permission fields for authorization checking.
